sentences.en: An opinion is shocking only if it is a conviction.
sentences.zh: 一个意见只有在它是确信的时候才会让人震惊。

sentences.en: I have a strong conviction that our judgement was right.
sentences.zh: 我坚信我们的判断是正确的。

sentences.en: Part of this conviction is rooted in my own experience.
sentences.zh: 这种确信部分源于我的亲身经历。
